content: {"phoneNote":"The framed hero card pushes the workshop photo almost entirely below the first screen, so only a sliver of the arch peeks in behind the directions bar.","desktopNote":"The hero works well as a composition, but the arched photo is cut flat at the viewport edge and the circular strap photo later sits in a huge wine band with a lot of dead space below it.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":3,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":3,"clutter":4,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["On phone, shrink the hero card (smaller description, remove the ornament) so the workshop photo arch is visible in the first screen.","Tighten the wine strap section on desktop: reduce the padding above and below the circular photo so it does not leave a dead band.","Give the services list a visual anchor (a small photo or price column aligned for all rows) so unpriced rows don't leave a ragged empty right side on desktop."],"blockers":[]}
